ValidationRule.description: when a DCR status changed to Approved, Approved by system, Cancelled or Rejected then DRD/APS Users will not be able to change the status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR($Profile.Name = "DRD Manager" || $Profile.Name = "DRD Profile", CONTAINS($Profile.Name, "APS") ), ISCHANGED(sked_Status__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(sked_Status__c), "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(sked_Status__c), "Approved by System"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(sked_Status__c), "Cancelled"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(sked_Status__c), "Rejected") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Once the DCR is Approved, Approved by System, Rejected, or Cancelled, the user is not allowed to change the status.
